gloss: way of taking something (mentally); interpretation; reaction

definitions.gloss: way of taking (something said or done); way of interpreting; way of reacting to
definitions.explanation: How a person mentally or emotionally takes in something — news, criticism, an event, or another person's words. Emphasizes that different people may react or interpret things in different ways.

examples.japanese: {受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまだ。
examples.english: People take the news in all sorts of different ways.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even the same words can hurt depending on how you take them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}められる→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧だ。
examples.english: Whether a child can take the teacher's advice in good faith depends on how that child reacts to it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧ (to catch, receive; to take in or come to terms with) and the suffix ～⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way of, manner of). The verb ⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧ originally means to catch a ball or other physical thing, but is overwhelmingly used figuratively for taking in news, criticism, reality, or emotions.

USAGE:
Commonly used in discussions about communication, interpretation, and differing perspectives. Emphasizes the subjective side — how the listener or observer takes something, rather than the objective message.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: the way of taking it differs
- {受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧: depending on how one takes it
- ⟦{人|ひと}それぞれ→人それぞれ：24844_hitosorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}: each person's own way of taking it
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{止|と}め{方|かた}: the public's reaction (often in news commentary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧{取|と}り{方|かた}: way of receiving/interpreting — very close in meaning; slightly more neutral and often used for physical or literal interpretation
- ⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧: interpretation — emphasizes analytical, deliberate interpretation
- ⟦{捉|とら}え{方|かた}→捉え方：18881_toraekata⟧: way of grasping/perceiving — emphasizes how one conceptualizes something
- ⟦{感|かん}じ→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: way of feeling — emphasizes emotional reaction rather than mental interpretation
